name: enhancement
description: Category: a new feature or an improvement

name: needs-triage

name: ready-for-human
description: State: needs a human, for judgment, the lab, hardware, or access

name: epic
description: A roadmap milestone. Its sub-issues are the tickets. Has no category or state.
